3.happening: The strings have different lengths ({len(s)} vs {len(t)}).
3.why: Anagrams must use exactly the same characters, so lengths must match.
3.invariant: Unequal lengths can never be anagrams.

3.happening: The strings are the same length.
3.why: Equal length is necessary before comparing sorted characters.
3.invariant: Only equal-length strings reach the comparison.

4.happening: We return False for the length mismatch.
4.why: No rearrangement can fix a length difference.
4.invariant: The verdict is decided without sorting.

5.happening: We sort the characters of s.
5.why: Anagrams have identical sorted character sequences.
5.invariant: s_chars is s's characters in order.

6.happening: We sort the characters of t.
6.why: We compare it against the sorted s.
6.invariant: t_chars is t's characters in order.

7.why: The two sorted rows are compared left to right.
7.invariant: i marks the position being compared.

8.happening: We assume the strings match until shown otherwise.
8.why: answer flips to False on the first difference.
8.invariant: answer is True while all compared positions agree.

9.happening: We compare position {i} of the two sorted rows.
9.why: Every position must agree for an anagram.

10.why: A single differing position rules out an anagram.
Matching characters keep the anagram possibility alive.
10.invariant: All positions up to i agree.

11.why: The sorted rows differ, so they are not anagrams.
11.invariant: answer is False once any position differs.

12.happening: We stop at the first mismatch.
12.why: One difference already settles the verdict.
12.invariant: No later positions can change a False verdict.

13.happening: We advance to the next position.
13.why: This position matched, so keep checking.

14.why: It is True only if every sorted position matched.
14.invariant: The verdict reflects the full comparison.

init.happening: Sort both strings and set up the comparison.

check.happening: Test lengths or a character position.
check.why: A difference rules out an anagram.
check.invariant: Only exact matches keep answer True.
